title: "[Solver] "

### Hypothesis

Which bottleneck or physical error could this improve? What result would disprove it?

### Experiment

Scene, algorithm/reference, fixed settings, hardware needs, quality measurements and complete timing. Include the smallest useful repro command if available.

### Integration

Which modules change? How will the editable garment model and existing backends remain usable?

### Evidence / sources

Public paper or documentation links, observed results, current limitations, and provenance for any reused code/data. AI-assisted experiments are welcome; identify what was actually tested.
